program: GLHS R4 — Governed Read-to-Write Continuity (GRWC) Phase 0
phase: Phase 0 — Prospective Experimental & Statistical Plan for R4 (E15–E22)
title: GLHS R4 Prospective Experimental and Statistical Plan: Dispatch Attestation, Prior-Art Comparison, Insufficiency Witnesses, and Formal Assurance

global_parameters.isolation_safeguard: Jitter repetitions are strictly isolated as secondary robustness probes to eliminate pseudoreplication. Primary sample sizes represent unique, independent logical schedules.
global_parameters.claim_eligibility_rule: A result is CLAIM_ELIGIBLE only when protocol freeze precedes execution, raw byte artifacts exist and pass checksum verification, backend truthfulness is attested, and claim wording strictly complies with claim budget policies.

E15.title: Dispatch Attestation Integrity Protocol under Adversarial Perturbation
E15.scientific_unit: unique logical adversarial dispatch attestation schedule
primary_research_questions: What is the invalid admission rate of the GLHS dispatch attestation kernel across 16 prespecified attack classes (A01–A16)?
Does the clean-control admission rate maintain 100.0% liveness without false-stale aborts?

attack_classes.name: snapshot_id_substitution
attack_classes.description: Replacing source snapshot UUID with an un-attested snapshot identifier.

attack_classes.name: projection_digest_corruption
attack_classes.description: Mutating projection digest H_proj while retaining valid attestation token.

attack_classes.name: request_envelope_digest_corruption
attack_classes.description: Mutating request envelope digest H_env while retaining valid attestation token.

attack_classes.name: undisclosed_evidence_injection
attack_classes.description: Injecting evidence fingerprint added at proposal time not present in attested disclosure.

attack_classes.name: disclosed_evidence_stripping
attack_classes.description: Omitting evidence item present in snapshot from prompt payload prior to provider dispatch.

attack_classes.name: cross_actor_credential_reuse
attack_classes.description: Replaying attestation token issued for Actor A1 under credentials of Actor A2.

attack_classes.name: cross_purpose_context_reuse
attack_classes.description: Replaying attestation token issued for Purpose P1 under Purpose P2.

attack_classes.name: cross_task_context_reuse
attack_classes.description: Replaying attestation token issued for Task T1 under Task T2.

attack_classes.name: historic_attestation_nonce_replay
attack_classes.description: Replaying an expired or already-committed attestation nonce.

attack_classes.name: human_review_lineage_laundering
attack_classes.description: Attempting to commit human-adapted proposal with base_version_only lineage stripping.

attack_classes.name: prompt_template_version_drift
attack_classes.description: Modifying system/user prompt template version between compilation and dispatch.

attack_classes.name: unbound_provider_fallback
attack_classes.description: Executing un-attested provider fallback upon primary model timeout.

attack_classes.name: stale_retry_context_mutation
attack_classes.description: Re-submitting retried request with mutated context under original attestation.

attack_classes.name: cross_profile_projection_mismatch
attack_classes.description: Binding patient P_A's attestation token to patient P_B's proposal.

attack_classes.name: signature_hmac_tampering
attack_classes.description: Modifying dispatch token HMAC signature bytes.

attack_classes.name: malformed_attestation_payload
attack_classes.description: Truncating or corrupting CBOR/JSON attestation envelope.

E15.stopping_rules: Halt immediately if any adversarial schedule in A01–A16 achieves admission (Gate 1 failure).

E16.title: Five-Way Prior-Art Comparator Architecture Study
E16.scientific_unit: unique logical schedule evaluated across all 5 comparator arms

C0.name: CURRENT_STATE_ONLY
C0.description: Re-evaluates authorization and version predicates against DB state at commit time without read-set or disclosure tracking.

C1.name: OCC_READSET
C1.description: Classical Optimistic Concurrency Control (Kung-Robinson / DynamoDB conditional writes) tracking entity key-version read-sets.

C2.name: PROVENANCE_ONLY
C2.description: W3C PROV retrospective lineage tracking entities and activity history without forward commit binding.

C3.name: SIGNED_EXACT_DISCLOSURE_TOKEN
C3.description: Macaroon/PCFS-style HMAC capability token holding exact disclosure digest H_proj, read-set entity version caveats R_readset, and contextual caveats.

C4.name: FULL_GRWC
C4.description: GLHS Governed Read-to-Write Continuity: two-digest server binding (H_proj + H_env), dependency closure, immutable proposal lineage, and same-transaction SSI commit locks.

E16.stopping_rules: If C3 matches C4 in decision safety (zero invalid admissions across all tested adversarial schedules), GLHS R4 explicitly surrenders any claim of decision-safety superiority over compact capability tokens and restricts its claims strictly to full-lifecycle state-machine governance, server-attested two-digest dispatch receipts, tamper-evident lineage binding, and bit-exact forensic audit reconstructability (Gate 2).

E17.title: Current-State Insufficiency Witness Protocol
E17.primary_research_question: Do deterministic proposal pairs exist where commit-time database state and governance are completely identical, causing C0 (CURRENT_STATE_ONLY) and C1 (OCC_READSET) to admit invalid substituted proposals while C3/C4 reject them?
E17.scenario_design: P_good is derived from disclosure D_good containing allergy disclosure. P_substituted is derived from D_bad (allergy omitted) proposing contraindicated drug. Commit-time DB state (v=1, policy epoch e=1, consent active) is identical.
E17.stopping_rules: Halt if C4 fails to reject any P_substituted witness scenario.

E18.title: Global Source Support vs. Disclosed Support Separation Protocol
E18.scientific_unit: logical schedule with evidence present in DB but excluded from prompt disclosure
E18.primary_research_question: Does C1 (OCC_READSET) improperly admit proposals asserting evidence present in the global DB but omitted from prompt projection, whereas C4 (FULL_GRWC) strictly rejects with evidence_undisclosed?
E18.stopping_rules: Halt if C4 admits any proposal containing undisclosed evidence.

E19.title: Transport Serialization Attack Resistance Protocol
E19.primary_research_question: Does the GLHS two-digest binding (H_proj + H_env) independently detect and reject transport-level mutations while preserving projection integrity?
E19.stopping_rules: Halt if any mutated transport payload passes gateway attestation.

E20.title: Optional Provider Verifiable Receipt Attestation Study
E20.conditionality_rule: Executed ONLY if live provider hardware/verifiable receipt capabilities are active in environment. Otherwise set status to NOT_RUN_PROVIDER_ATTESTATION_UNAVAILABLE.

E21.title: Formal Novelty Model & State-Space Assurance (Invariants I16–I24)
E21.scientific_unit: formal state-space state and transition step in TLA+/Alloy model checker
E21.stopping_rules: Halt submission if TLC/Alloy finds any invariant violation under GRWC up to depth d=6.

E22.title: R4 Public Reproducibility & Fresh Checkout Audit Protocol
E22.scientific_unit: fresh git clone checkout execution pass
steps: 1. Environment verification and Python/PostgreSQL dependency validation
2. Verification of frozen commit SHAs and protocol JSON SHA256 checksums
3. Automated re-execution of E15 through E21 experiment runners
4. Exact binary/statistical output comparison against frozen baseline
5. Automated generation of R4 Publication Audit Report
E22.stopping_rules: Disallow public claim release if any reproduction checksum fails (Gate 5).
